svg.title: Herringbone Brick Paving: plan
svg.desc: Plan of brick paving laid in a 45-degree herringbone, each brick at right angles to its neighbour, framed by a row of bricks set end-on along the walls. Source: Standard UK brick 215 × 102.5 mm; 45° herringbone bond. Original drawing by Project Exodus.

g.text: BRICKS AT 45° IN A ZIG-ZAG, EDGED BY A SOLDIER COURSE
SOURCE: Standard UK brick 215 × 102.5 mm; 45° herringbone bond.
